procedure.method: In this fresh independent session I read the pinned packet/case, rules, rubric, ratio policy and compact recording instructions, verified declared input hashes/bytes, and read all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded paths. The packet declares no source assets or protected-layout manifests, so there were no source opens or protected-layout reads. I actually opened and visually inspected the exact pinned poster PNGs using tools.view_image, forwarding each returned image through functions.exec with original detail, in this order: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same view order. All fifteen initial views were complete before the first deliberate copy-reading/transcription stage, any judgment or any score. Native views were 1672×941; use views 720×405; thumbnails 320×180. The tool calls, not filenames or helper exits, supplied the viewed images. After all fifteen views and the initial readings of the relevant time lines, I made one exact native revisit of M1 and one of M2 for time-range glyph ambiguity: seventeen actual poster opens in total. No images were produced, edited, cropped or substituted. No unlisted paths, peer reviews, maker self-inspections or planner narratives were read, and no agents were spawned, resumed or forked. No tool-event identifier or runtime session ID is invented.

typography.location: brush-like Korean explanation and sans-serif logistics

space.location: left copy margins and diagonal chair boundary
space.observation: The diagonal wood and clothing contours occupy the right side without becoming a rectangular split-field block. The left stack has a consistent start margin, enough width for the explanation, and clearance from the hands.

image_material.location: hand hatching, wood joint and garment patch
image_material.observation: The limited navy/red marks and cream paper treatment are coherent across skin, wood and cloth. Cut-like lines distinguish the materials while leaving the joint and sewn patch legible.

emotion_control.location: large collaborative hands and red accents
emotion_control.observation: The direct hand gestures and tactile print treatment convey confident, practical community help. Red links the event date and active repair hands without overwhelming the explanation.

ai_slop.location: wood tenon, holding fingers and sewing line
ai_slop.observation: The open tenon, supporting grip, patch edge and needle/thread describe identifiable tasks. Distressed marks share a print logic, with no arbitrary icon or unrelated ornament added to the message.

residuals: The print treatment and continuous column are resolved, but the broad chair/patch motif is familiar rather than exceptionally refined.

evidence.observation: Illustrated repair vignettes encircle a wide cream opening; the top-right title, central invitation and three-column logistics form a broad lateral route. evidence.observation: A torn joint, torn denim, patch result and active hands form an angular close-up collage. White title at lower left and slogan at upper right bracket a pale central information polygon. The fragmentation and before/action/result editing differ from the continuous scenes of M1 and M4.

evidence.location: centered participants and foreground sewing
evidence.observation: Two painterly full figures repair a chair between left explanation and right event text; an enlarged sewing crop crosses the foreground. Relative to M2, the right-side title remains, but the hero changes from dispersed perimeter hands to a central social partnership and the application details shift to lower left.

evidence.location: red date-led left column and right diagonal engraving
evidence.observation: The red serif date leads a continuous left reading column with expressive Korean copy and sans-serif logistics. A large diagonal two-ink chair/garment engraving fills the right. This changes focal order, type roles, route and image organization, not only the material, compared with the preceding four.

residuals: The five separate posters satisfy count fidelity and show substantive structural diversity at 4; no common title/hero/footer scaffold explains the whole set.

Chair-and-patch imagery recurs by brief, and M2/M4 share a title-right/invitation-left relationship. Four posters use predominantly sans-serif type, so the set is distinct without being maximally divergent.
M2 and M3 retain hierarchy scores of 3; M4 retains hierarchy and space scores of 3. Those low judgments are preserved without averaging.
